meta.unit_gdp: EUR million, chain-linked volumes, reference year 2015
meta.unit_pc: EUR per inhabitant, chain-linked volumes, reference year 2015

sources.ES: Eurostat nama_10_gdp (B1GQ, CLV15_MEUR) / nama_10_pc (B1GQ, CLV15_EUR_HAB); population nama_10_pe (POP_NC) or demo_gind (AVG) where per-capita is not published. Extracted 2026-09-07.
sources.IMF: IMF World Economic Outlook, April 2026 (NGDP_RPCH real growth, LP population, NGDPD nominal USD GDP for the 2015 anchor)
sources.WB: World Bank WDI (NY.GDP.MKTP.KD constant 2015 USD, SP.POP.TOTL), last updated 2026-07-13; used only for growth back-casts where Eurostat and IMF are silent (MLT 1995-1999, MNE 1997-1999, BIH population before 2000), and as cross-check. The Malta 1999-2000 link uses UN National Accounts Main Aggregates growth (see country note).
sources.NAT: national statistics office: UK Office for National Statistics (ABMI real GDP release 2026-08-12; UKPOP mid-year population release 2025-11-27)
sources.FC: forecast: IMF World Economic Outlook April 2026 projections (real growth and population) chained forward from the 2025 value (2026-2031)

ALB.name: Albania
ALB.note: GDP 2025 chained from IMF WEO real growth (Eurostat volumes start 1995). Per-capita 2023-2025 computed as GDP / Eurostat demo_gind average population (Eurostat does not publish CLV15 per-capita for these years). 2026-2031: IMF WEO April 2026 real-growth and population projections. Population 2023-2025 is Eurostat demo_gind (INSTAT, 2023-census based: 2.58 M in 2023, 2.38 M in 2024) while 2022 and earlier is the pre-census national-accounts population (2.78 M in 2022); the per-capita steps of +12% in 2023 and +13% in 2024 are this documented census break, not real growth. IMF WEO still carries the pre-census 2.75 M for 2023.

BIH.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
BIH.note: GDP 1995-1999 chained from IMF WEO real growth (Eurostat volumes start 2000). Population 1995-2009, 2025 chained from IMF WEO / World Bank WDI (UN WPP) growth off the nearest Eurostat level. 2026-2031: IMF WEO April 2026 real-growth and population projections. Bosnia population 2010-2024 is on the 2013-census basis (BHAS via Eurostat, 3.54 M in 2010); pre-2010 Eurostat demographic figures are on the old 3.8 M basis, so population 1995-2009 is back-cast from the 2010 level with UN WPP growth instead.

MLT.name: Malta
MLT.note: GDP 1995-1999 chained from World Bank WDI constant-2015-USD real growth (Eurostat volumes start 2000). Population 1995-1999 chained from IMF WEO growth off the nearest Eurostat level. 2026-2031: IMF WEO April 2026 real-growth and population projections. Malta 1995-1999: Eurostat volumes start 2000 and IMF growth starts 2001, so back-cast with World Bank constant-2015-USD growth for 1996-1999; the 1999-2000 link uses UN National Accounts Main Aggregates real growth (6.7%) because the World Bank series has a splice jump (+19.7%) in 2000. Population Eurostat nama_10_pe.

MNE.name: Montenegro
MNE.note: GDP 1997-2005 chained from IMF WEO / World Bank WDI constant-2015-USD real growth (Eurostat volumes start 2006). Per-capita 1997-2005 computed as GDP / Eurostat demo_gind average population (Eurostat does not publish CLV15 per-capita for these years). 2026-2031: IMF WEO April 2026 real-growth and population projections. Montenegro: IMF growth starts 2001, World Bank constant-price GDP starts 1997; 1995-1996 GDP unavailable (null). UN National Accounts Main Aggregates growth for 1998-2000 (4.6 / -8.3 / +14.5%) disagrees with the World Bank (4.9 / -9.4 / +3.1%) used here. Population 1995-2005 Eurostat demo_gind (same basis as national accounts).

SRB.name: Serbia
SRB.territory: GDP excl. Kosovo (SORS/Eurostat basis); Eurostat per-capita 1995-1998 uses a population incl. Kosovo
SRB.note: Eurostat nama_10_gdp / nama_10_pc verbatim 1995-2025; 2026-2031 IMF WEO April 2026 real-growth and population projections applied to the 2025 Eurostat values. Serbia: Eurostat GDP volumes exclude Kosovo throughout, but the Eurostat per-capita series for 1995-1998 divides by a population that still includes Kosovo (9.7-9.8 M vs 7.5 M from 1999), so per-capita 1995-1998 is understated by roughly 22% and steps up in 1999. Values kept verbatim as published.

UKR.name: Ukraine

anchor.source: Level taken verbatim from Eurostat nama_10_gdp (UA, CLV15_MEUR) for 2010-2024; the IMF NGDPD anchor (90.981 bn USD / 1.1095 = 82002 MEUR) differs from it by -0.25%

UKR.territory: excl. Crimea and Sevastopol and the occupied parts of Donetsk and Luhansk from 2014 (Ukrstat basis); resident population from 2022 reflects wartime displacement
UKR.note: GDP 2010-2024 verbatim from Eurostat nama_10_gdp (Ukrstat data transmitted to Eurostat); 1995-2009 back-cast with IMF WEO real growth; 2025 IMF estimate. Population: Eurostat demo_gind average population 1996-2020, extended 2021-2025 with IMF WEO population growth (reflects wartime displacement from 2022); 1995 back-cast with IMF. 2026 IMF projection. The 2014 drop (-6.5% real, and -5.5% population) is the exclusion of Crimea and occupied Donbas; 2022 is the full-scale invasion (-28.8%).
